onboarding.title: Automatic Agent setup
onboarding.intro: AgentPort checks your interactive shell, version managers, and common install directories, then selects only a version that passes read-only validation. Manual setup is usually unnecessary.

onboarding.adapterNote: Open advanced options only when automatic detection fails. Unknown CLIs still need a matching adapter so they are never started with unmanaged arguments.
